context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 verified Gemini 3 Flash and GPT-5 integrations. Key findings: (1) GET /api/agents/providers returns 5 providers with correct priorities: Claude=1, Gemini=2, GPT-5=3, Groq=4, OpenRouter=5. (2) Default fallback order is ['claude', 'gemini', 'gpt5', 'groq', 'openrouter']. (3) POST /api/agents/chat accepts preferred_provider field. (4) GPT-5 works correctly end-to-end with provider='gpt5' in response. (5) Claude works correctly with provider='claude'. (6) Gemini 3 Flash works for simple queries; falls back to Claude for complex prompts (None guard in _call_gemini). (7) Frontend PROVIDERS constant has 6 options (Auto + 5 providers). (8) Provider selector has data-testid='provider-selector'. (9) Provider badges show correct colors: GPT-5=#10a37f, Claude=#a78bfa, Gemini=#4285f4. (10) Footer shows '5 LLM providers', header shows '21 Tools'.

GET /api/agents/providers.details: Returns 5 providers with correct priorities: Claude=1, Gemini=2, GPT-5=3, Groq=4, OpenRouter=5. Fallback order is ['claude', 'gemini', 'gpt5', 'groq', 'openrouter'].

POST /api/agents/chat with preferred_pro.details: Accepts preferred_provider field for claude, gemini, gpt5, groq, openrouter, auto

Task with preferred_provider='gpt5'.details: Task completes using GPT-5, provider field shows 'gpt5' in response

Task with preferred_provider='claude'.details: Task completes using Claude, provider field shows 'claude' in response

Task with preferred_provider='gemini'.details: Simple queries work with Gemini directly. Complex prompts fall back to Claude (expected behavior due to None guard).

_call_gemini function.details: Uses gemini-3-flash-preview model via emergentintegrations LlmChat. Has None guard for fallback.

_call_gpt5 function.details: Uses gpt-5 model via emergentintegrations LlmChat

Frontend provider selector.details: Dropdown with data-testid='provider-selector' shows all 6 options: Auto, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5, Groq/Llama 3.3, OpenRouter

Frontend provider badges.details: GPT-5 badge (#10a37f green), Claude badge (#a78bfa purple), Gemini badge (#4285f4 blue) display correctly on responses
